args.question: To produce a shortlist that is genuinely eligible, credit-transferable, and affordable—not just a generic comparison—please provide the following details.
args.context: Exchange eligibility, tuition waivers, credit conversion, visa rules, and application routes depend heavily on your home university, citizenship, degree stage, timing, and language credentials. If an item is unknown, enter “unknown.”

fields.name: home_institution
fields.label: Current university, school/department, and degree program
fields.placeholder: e.g., XX University, School of Journalism, MA in Communication

fields.name: citizenship
fields.label: Passport citizenship / region
fields.placeholder: Needed for visa and funding eligibility

fields.name: target_timing
fields.label: Preferred term and year
fields.placeholder: e.g., Spring 2027; include earliest/latest acceptable dates

fields.name: home_credit_rules
fields.label: Known home-university requirements for credit recognition
fields.placeholder: Required credits/contact hours, preapproval process, grade requirements, thesis/residency restrictions, or “unknown”

fields.name: partner_information
fields.label: Known overseas partner universities or exchange-program webpage
fields.placeholder: Paste names/URL if available; institutional exchanges are often the safest route for credit and tuition waivers

fields.name: language_credentials
fields.label: Language ability and test scores
fields.placeholder: IELTS/TOEFL/Duolingo, Japanese JLPT, other languages; include scores and dates or planned tests

fields.name: academic_record
fields.label: Approximate GPA/average and notable research experience
fields.placeholder: Useful for eligibility and scholarship realism

fields.name: budget
fields.label: Maximum total out-of-pocket budget for one term
fields.placeholder: State currency; indicate whether airfare, housing, insurance, and tuition are included

fields.name: funding_priority
fields.label: Funding requirement
options: Must be fully or almost fully funded
Partial funding preferred but not essential

fields.name: constraints
fields.label: Other constraints or preferences
fields.placeholder: Preferred countries/cities, maximum weeks, accessibility/health, housing needs, dietary issues, risk tolerance, etc.

all_observed_tools.name: ask_clarification
all_observed_tools.content:
❓ Exchange eligibility, tuition waivers, credit conversion, visa rules, and application routes depend heavily on your home university, citizenship, degree stage, timing, and language credentials. If an item is unknown, enter “unknown.”

To produce a shortlist that is genuinely eligible, credit-transferable, and affordable—not just a generic comparison—please provide the following details.

  1. Current university, school/department, and degree program (required)
  2. Degree level and current year (required) — options: Master’s—Year 1 / Master’s—Year 2 or later / PhD—Year 1 / PhD—Year 2 or later / Other
  3. Passport citizenship / region (required)
  4. Preferred term and year (required)
  5. Acceptable program formats (required) — options: Course-based semester exchange / Research visiting student / lab placement / Summer/winter school with transferable credit / Hybrid coursework plus supervised research (multiple allowed)
  6. Known home-university requirements for credit recognition
  7. Known overseas partner universities or exchange-program webpage
  8. Primary academic goal (required) — options: New-media technology coursework / Public-opinion / computational communication research / Methods training (Python/data/AI) / Thesis or dissertation progress / Academic networking / PhD preparation / Industry and policy exposure / Cross-cultural experience (multiple allowed)
  9. Language ability and test scores (required)
  10. Approximate GPA/average and notable research experience
  11. Maximum total out-of-pocket budget for one term (required)
  12. Funding requirement (required) — options: Must be fully or almost fully funded / Need substantial scholarship support / Partial funding preferred but not essential / Can self-fund within stated budget
  13. Other constraints or preferences

Please reply with a value for each field.
